definition: The number of contracts open: each new position adds, each closing trade subtracts.
boundaries: Its clock differs by venue: CME publishes it at the end of each day, final the next morning; Binance gives it live and keeps one month through its API (its archive goes back further). A reading must say which.
recognition: Rising open interest with price confirms a trend; falling warns it tires.

class_meanings.fx: none: spot FX has no contracts open; currency futures carry it.
class_meanings.metal: none for spot CFDs; the COMEX future carries it.
class_meanings.index_cfd: none: the CFD has no exchange contracts; the index future carries it.
class_meanings.commodity_cfd: none: the underlying future carries it.
class_meanings.future: End-of-day total, published that evening and final the next morning.
class_meanings.perp: Live, with history in steps of 5 minutes and up.

sources.quote: contracts held by market participants at the end of the trading day
Only the data of the latest 1 month is available.
